text:
elaine: Quick sync 1 launch-post deliverables: keyword set, JSON-LD for webinar + benchmark pages, internal-link matrix (seed -> clusters), and redirects for legacy blog slugs. Need edits locked by EOD Wed.
marco: I can own keywords + anchor CSV. will prioritize product features and benchmark narratives. ETA today.
jamal: I'll draft two JSON-LD snippets: Event (webinar) and Article (benchmark). small example for Event to paste in head: ```json
{\n  "@context": "https://schema.org",\n  "@type": "Event",\n  "name": "Redwood Inference: Launch & Benchmark",\n  "startDate": "2026-04-14T17:00:00Z",\n  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar"}\n}
```
sophia: I pulled old /blog/* slugs (pre-2024) into the Redirects sheet: https://drive.google.com/redirects. thinking 302 for initial test, then 301 once canonical verified. pinging infra for maintenance window 02:00-04:00 UTC.
elainE: (typo) meant @sophia pls add "anchor_rewrites" col with standard CTAs to webinar + demo.
sophia: done. example anchors: "see benchmark results" -> /benchmark, "request a demo" -> /demo-request.
seo-bot: crawl-scan: benchmark-drafts contains 9 images missing alt text; 2 internal links returning 404. see sheet row refs.
marco: will fix alts + broken anchors. for internal linking, propose: seed (launch overview) -> benchmark, integration, pricing, migration guide, customer story. anchor text examples: "launch benchmarks", "how to integrate", "cost/perf comparison". keep max 2 contextual links per cluster.
elaine: marco please output CSV columns: source_url, target_url, anchor_text, reason. drop in the drive folder.
marco: doing it now, ETA 3pm PST. :thumbsup:
jamal: QA note when you add JSON-LD, validate with Rich Results Test and Lighthouse. I'll run a smoke validation pass after you commit.
sophia: redirect rules draft for infra (nginx examples) in sheet comments: ```nginx
# temp 302
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /new-blog/$1 redirect;
# then convert to 301 after 14d
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /new-blog/$1 permanent;
```
elaine: final checklist by EOD Wed:
- marco: KW list + anchor CSV
- jamal: schema snippets + validation report
- sophia: redirect sheet + rollout plan
- elaine: stitch copy + CTA placements (one primary CTA = webinar sign-up)
marco: ack
sophia: ack, will coordinate with infra and schedule during low traffic window
jamal: ack, will queue validation once JSON-LD is live
elaine: one more: limit on-page CTAs on top-of-funnel posts to single CTA to avoid dilution. we'll iterate based on traffic and benchmark engagement. :rocket:
